headline: With ‘Barely Breathing’, Duncan Sheik Became an Accidental Pop Star
context: Sheik’s song “Barely Breathing” spent 55 weeks on the Billboard Hot 100 chart in the late 1990s. But the success only propelled him closer to Broadway.
